title: A rolling deployment
hints: Remember the old version of every server before you change it: a dictionary from name to version.
Walk the servers in batches: for start in range(0, len(servers), batch_size): batch = servers[start:start + batch_size].
First update every server of the batch, then check each with healthy(server). At the first unhealthy one, restore all updated servers and return the rolled_back result.
Servers that already run the new version are skipped: not updated, not checked, not listed.
